By default, the C2 server would respond to the aforementioned A record requests with '0.0.0.0' when the malware should remain inactive.

By tracking DNS responses of '0.0.0.0', Gigamon ATR detected new attacker infrastructure even when not discovered by other heuristics, as well as tracked periods of attacker inactivity to further cement a profile of FIN7's operational habits.
